hot_wallet.label: illustrative policy; real inscription and transfers on a local validator; verdicts scripted
rules: Never send more than $1,000,000 to a wallet not registered to the exchange.
Never send more than $50,000,000 in total per day.
Only pay out to wallets on the declared withdrawal list.
A newly registered address cannot receive funds until 24 hours after registration.
Never send more than 10% of the hot wallet balance in one withdrawal.
If any rule is broken, refuse the withdrawal and hold it for human review.

steps.what: withdrawal request: to, amountUsd, registered, sentTodayUsd, registeredHoursAgo

limits: Poisoned evidence can fool every juror: a forged correction fooled all 10 models in our test.
A ruling takes 20 to 60 seconds and about a cent or less in model calls.
